tytul: Greek-style yogurt drained in cheesecloth (Illinois Extension recipe)
wstep: This card makes yogurt by the University of Illinois Extension basic recipe and then drains it in the refrigerator for 2–4 hours into Greek-style yogurt.

akapity: FDA lists yogurt made from unpasteurized milk among high-risk foods.
Drain the yogurt covered and in the refrigerator, not on the kitchen counter.
Illinois Extension uses 1 quart of 1% low-fat milk and 2 tablespoons of plain non-fat yogurt with live cultures as the starter.
JarAtlas rule (cautious): make this yogurt only from pasteurized milk.
Heat the milk slowly to 180–185 °F (82–85 °C), stirring occasionally and checking the temperature with a thermometer.
Let it cool to 108–115 °F (42–46 °C).
Stir the starter into 1 cup of the warm milk until smooth, then pour it back into the pot and stir.
Pour the milk into containers with lids and incubate at 108–115 °F (42–46 °C) for 6–10 hours without moving them.
As soon as the yogurt has set, move it to the refrigerator at 40 °F (4.4 °C) or lower.
Cut a piece of cheesecloth twice as wide as the bowl and fold it in half into a double layer.
Spoon the yogurt into the cloth and secure the cloth so it hangs above the bottom of the bowl.
Cover the container and let the yogurt drain in the refrigerator.
For Greek-style yogurt, Illinois Extension drains it for 2–4 hours.
Draining for 8–24 hours gives a thicker yogurt cheese instead.
Keep the drained yogurt in the refrigerator at 40 °F (4.4 °C) or lower.
Illinois Extension says to eat home-made yogurt within 14 days.
JarAtlas rule (cautious): count the 14 days from the day you made the yogurt, not from the day you drained it.
Illinois Extension says yogurt does not set when the starter had no live cultures, the incubation was too hot or too cold, or the equipment was not clean.
Fermented dairy products must reach a pH of 4.6 or less within 48 hours to be considered pathogen-free.
JarAtlas rule (cautious): if the yogurt has not set by the end of the incubation time, do not drain it and do not eat it.
